Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: 3-day history of diarrhea and vomiting

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea began watery and became very loose
Approximately at least four episodes of diarrhea today, patient lost count
Vomiting with inability to keep liquids or food down
Last vomiting episode occurred about 2 hours ago after breakfast

History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Subjective fever ("literally boiling"); no thermometer reading

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Periumbilical abdominal pain that is tender to touch, crampy, intermittent, with strong urge to defecate
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Abdominal pain: periumbilical, tender to touch, crampy, intermittent with strong urge to defecate

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Passing urine, last void approximately 1 hour ago
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Urination: passing urine; last void ~1 hr ago
No blood in stool or urine
No blood in stool or urine

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Household exposure with brother having similar symptoms
Reports outbreak at school related to gastrointestinal illness
Has taken oral rehydration solution made as salt-sugar mix about three times per day for two days
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Self-care: ORS (salt-sugar mix) taken ~3x/day for 2 days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports vomiting limits the efficacy of oral rehydration solution

Past_Medical_History.content: Last menstrual period approximately two weeks ago

Medications.content: Takes occasional ibuprofen for menstrual cramps

Social_and_Family_History.content: Occasional alcohol use of about 1 pint
Working from home on the day of consultation

Assessment.content: Acute gastroenteritis with 3 days of watery diarrhea, vomiting, subjective fever, likely infectious (viral versus bacterial) with household contact
Assessment.source_text: 1. Acute gastroenteritis — 3 days watery diarrhea, vomiting, subjective fever; likely infectious (viral vs bacterial); household contact

Assessment.content: Periumbilical abdominal pain that is crampy, tender, associated with diarrheal urgency
Assessment.source_text: 2. Periumbilical abdominal pain — crampy, tender, associated with diarrheal urgency

Assessment.content: At risk of dehydration due to persistent vomiting and reduced oral intake but currently still voiding urine
Assessment.source_text: 3. Dehydration risk due to persistent vomiting and reduced oral intake (currently still voiding)

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange urgent clinic appointment via support line for assessment, hydration check, and same-day stool sample collection
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Arrange urgent clinic appointment via support line for assessment, hydration check and same-day stool sample collection

Plan_of_Care.content: Send stool sample for microbiology to exclude bacterial pathogen requiring specific therapy
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Send stool sample for microbiology (to exclude bacterial pathogen requiring specific therapy)

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise continuation of oral rehydration solution with very small, frequent sips and to persist despite vomiting where tolerable
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Rehydration: continue ORS; very small, frequent sips; persist despite vomiting where tolerable

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise bland and light diet such as toast or biscuit, avoiding fruit, vegetables, and milk
No immediate medications prescribed during the call
Plan_of_Care.source_text: No immediate medications prescribed on call

Plan_of_Care.content: Consider targeted therapy if stool results indicate bacterial infection
Plan_of_Care.source_text: consider targeted therapy if stool results indicate bacterial infection

Follow_up_Information.content: If symptoms worsen or patient is unable to keep fluids down, she should go to A&E urgently
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Safety-net: if symptoms worsen or unable to keep fluids, go to A&E urgently

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient advised to call back if her condition deteriorates
Follow_up_Information.source_text: patient advised to call back if deteriorates
